title: Auto-Remediation Pipeline
brief: Convert 71 warn rules to auto-fix. Target 80%+ auto-fixed. git auto-rewrite, output auto-cap, re-read redirect, glob combine, grep skip/scope, agent redirect, TSC auto-fix, type annotate, auto-compact, action restore, rate throttle, docs redirect, scorecard.

phases.title: Core Auto-Fix Infrastructure
phases.description: Build the auto-remediation framework and implement the highest-impact auto-fix rules (git rewrite, output cap, re-read redirect, glob combine).

units.title: Git Auto-Rewrite
units.rationale: Auto-fix git commands that trigger warn rules (e.g., git add -A to specific files, amend to new commit) by intercepting and rewriting before execution.
exit_conditions: Git rewrite interceptor handles top 5 git warn patterns
Tests pass for each rewrite pattern
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Catalog all git-related warn rules from pretooluse-unified and hookify
Implement git command rewriter in pretooluse-unified that transforms warned commands to safe equivalents
Add tests for each rewrite pattern (add -A, amend, force push, etc.)

deliverables.description: Git auto-rewrite logic in PreToolUse hook

phases.title: Search & Agent Auto-Fix
phases.description: Auto-fix grep and agent warn rules: skip grep-on-just-read, auto-scope grep-no-path, redirect simple agent queries.

units.title: Grep-After-Read Skip
units.rationale: When a grep targets a file just read, auto-skip and return results from the cached read content instead of re-searching.
entry_conditions: File read cache from P0-U03 available
exit_conditions: Grep on recently-read file auto-returns filtered cached content
No false skips on changed files
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
